summary_claims.claim: Art. 1(2) scope to state agencies and organisations/individuals using AI for state management or public services; Art. 1(3) others encouraged

Four principle groups follow Art. 3(1)-(4); safe design from the outset ('Thiet ke an toan ngay tu dau'), internal testing before deployment, human control, 'dau doc du lieu' / 'dau doc mo hinh' (data/model poisoning, defined in Art. 2)
Art. 5(1) review every 3 years or on major change
Annex I guidance per group of actors; Annex II self-assessment form ('phieu tu danh gia')
